title: The Rough Current
author: J. M. Yarrow
blurb: Ada Okonkwo, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. But when an expedition upriver stops answering the radio, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the dry season ends.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
